title: An explicit filter argument overrides the filter made by the context transition on the same column

source.quote: context transition happens before further filters in CALCULATE
source.supports: the transition happens before the filter arguments are applied, so they can override its filters

source.quote: A filter argument overrides the existing corresponding filters over the same column(s), unless it is embedded within KEEPFILTERS
source.supports: a filter argument overrides the existing filter on the same column

derivation: On each row the transition filters Product[Color] to that row's color; the argument Product[Color] = "Red" then replaces it. Red sales: rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 = 100 + 40 + 20 + 200 + 100 = 460 on all three rows.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
